node.statement: Dependency import and exact-idempotence algebra: using the prerequisite conclusions of 1.1.1 and 1.1.2, we have X=2Q-I (so Q=(I+X)/2), S^2=I, S1=1, and ||S-X||_{inf->inf}<=24 eta. For P=(I+S)/2, P1=(1+1)/2=1 and P^2=(I+2S+S^2)/4=(I+S)/2=P, hence P is an exact signed idempotent by def-signed-idempotent.
